## Why This Is Asked
Tests offline caching basics, WorkManager scheduling, and simple data consistency using Room.

## Key Concepts
- Retrofit for network calls
- Room for local cache
- WorkManager with connectivity constraints
- Idempotent fetches using lastUpdated/token

## Code Example

```kotlin
@Entity(tableName = \"weather\")
data class WeatherData(
  @PrimaryKey val location: String,
  val temperature: Double,
  val condition: String,
  val lastUpdated: Long
)

@Dao
interface WeatherDao {
  @Query(\"SELECT * FROM weather WHERE location = :loc\")
  suspend fun get(loc: String): WeatherData?

  @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
  suspend fun upsert(data: WeatherData)
}
```

- How would you balance data freshness with cache size and network usage?
- How would you test offline-first behavior in CI with simulated connectivity?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests MVVM fundamentals, repository pattern, local caching with Room, and basic network handling with Retrofit. Also checks startup data flow, UI state management, and testability.

## Code Example

```javascript
// Kotlin-like pseudocode for quick reference
data class Note(val id: String, val text: String)
interface NoteDao { @Query("SELECT * FROM notes") fun getAll(): List<Note> @Insert fun insertAll(notes: List<Note>) }
interface NotesApi { @GET("/notes") suspend fun getNotes(): List<Note> }
class NotesRepository(val dao: NoteDao, val api: NotesApi) {
  suspend fun getNotes(): List<Note> {
    val local = dao.getAll()
    if (local.isNotEmpty()) return local
    val fresh = api.getNotes()
    dao.insertAll(fresh)
    return fresh
  }
}
```

- How would you handle data migrations if the schema changes?

```kotlin
// Minimal Add-Wins CRDT sketch
data class Dot(val actor: String, val clock: Long)
class AddWinsCRDT {
  private val adds = mutableMapOf<String, MutableSet<Long>>()
  fun add(e: String, d: Dot) { adds.computeIfAbsent(e) { mutableSetOf() }.add(d.clock) }
  fun value(): Set<String> = adds.filter { it.value.isNotEmpty() }.keys
}
```

## Why This Is Asked
This checks ability to design robust offline-first sync with per-field conflict resolution and cryptography.

## Key Concepts
- Room + encryption via Android Keystore; per-record keys
- Delta-based sync with revision counters; per-field merges
- Conflict UX and automated tests; offline-first durability

## Code Example
```kotlin
data class InventoryItem(
  val id: String,
  val name: String,
  val quantity: Int,
  val location: String?,
  val notes: String?,
  val lastModified: Long,
  val revision: Long
)

fun merge(a: InventoryItem, b: InventoryItem): InventoryItem {
  return InventoryItem(
    id = a.id,
    name = if (a.lastModified >= b.lastModified) a.name else b.name,
    quantity = if (a.lastModified >= b.lastModified) a.quantity else b.quantity,
    location = if (a.lastModified >= b.lastModified) a.location ?: "" else b.location ?: "",
    notes = if (a.lastModified >= b.lastModified) a.notes ?: "" else b.notes ?: "",
    lastModified = maxOf(a.lastModified, b.lastModified),
    revision = maxOf(a.revision, b.revision)
  )
}
```

- How would you test CRDT-like merges and ensure determinism across devices?
- How would you validate encryption key rotation and data retirement on logout?
